newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm, volume up.

text.p: Prices firmed on the Istanbul gold exchange on Wednesday in line with world trends, and volume rose on physical demand ahead of the new year, dealers said.
Gold closed at $369.70 an ounce, up from $368.80 on Tuesday, and at 1,253,750 lira per gram, versus the previous 1,246,600.
Volume rose to 700 kilos from Tuesday's 500 kilos.

"With the approach of the new year, there was physical demand mainly from jewellers. In the afternoon this demand had been satisfied and traders preferred not to take up positions due to uncertainty over the direction of gold abroad," one dealer said.
A weak lira boosted prices in lira terms. The Turkish lira ended at 105,530 to the dollar, after Tuesday's 105,200.
Morning turnover was 690 kilos, while 55.7 percent of all business was in dollar terms.
